text:
Avery: Quick heads-up — next Wednesday 11:00am PT we’ll run a 45m company huddle focused on platform state + product priorities. No slides salvo; short updates + Q&A. Please drop any questions below or add to the form: https://forms.gle/RedwoodAHQNA

Maya: Agenda draft — 1) 10m product roadmap highlights (releases + experiments), 2) 10m infra & latency story (recent wins + risks), 3) 10m Dedicated & Private launch callouts, 4) 15m open Q&A. Want to keep mic time light.

Tom: Adding a 2–3 minute demo of the new batching telemetry dashboard — will keep it tight.

Leah: Logistics: hybrid meeting (main office + Zoom). Recording will be posted. If you can’t make it, please leave one question in the form and we’ll surface it during Q&A.

Jonah: Heads-up for teams: if you plan to ask anything sensitive (customer or compliance), DM me or Leah so we can handle offline.

Avery: Can folks in Eng/Platform thread 1 slide (or 3 bullet update) in #eng by EOD Friday so we can trim agenda? No pressure — just callouts we should highlight.

Maya: Also collecting 1–2 success metrics to show (latency p50/p95, cost/unit improvements, adoption metrics). Put numbers + context in this thread if you want them called out.

Tom: Quick note — the infra incident last month is fully documented in the postmortem. I’ll summarize the mitigations and remaining action items during the infra block.

Leah: Can people react to this thread with :hand: if you plan to attend in person? Helps catering.

Avery: One more: exec ask — think about one cross-team dependency we should remove this quarter and bring that to the Q&A. We’ll pick 2–3 to take action on.

Maya: Recording link will be posted here afterward. I’ll also pin the agenda + docs in the channel.

Tom: +1 on the demo. Will post the telemetry GIF and short runbook reference before the huddle.

Leah: RSVP: in-person count so far — 14. If you need a calendar invite update (timezone fix), ping me.

Avery: Thanks all. If you’re on the product side and want a slot, call out here with your 2-line update.

Maya: Form responses so far: 9 questions — several about Dedicated autoscaling and one about private deployment networking. I’ll prioritize those in Q&A.

deploy-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood-recordings.company/1765443210-2026-03-25.mp4 (private link, org access only).

Leah: Posting final agenda at 9am PT on Wed plus the Zoom link. See you then! :calendar:
